semantics: initialize_wofost sets VERN=0 and FL_VERNALISED=.FALSE. at crop emergence.
IDSL2 uses the same DLO/DLC photoperiod reduction as IDSL1 before anthesis.
If not vernalised and DVS<VERNDVS, VERNRATE=AFGEN(VERNRTB,TAV) and VERNFAC=clamp((VERN-VERNBASE)/(VERNSAT-VERNBASE)).
If not vernalised and DVS>=VERNDVS, FL_VERNALISED is forced true and VERNFAC remains 1.
After potential/actual crop updates, VERN advances once by VERNRATE and saturation can set FL_VERNALISED.
FIRST_WARNING changes only warning emission, not crop physics.

remaining: Extend the classic rate parameter selector from IDSL0/1 to IDSL2 and compose the IDSL2 daily candidate into the one-day classic crop transaction.
Advance VERN exactly once per accepted daily event after potential and actual crop branches.
Qualify reject/replay/restart plus anthesis transition using the existing F-WOF38/39/41 gates as preservation.
